strategy_notes: FULL CASH PRESERVATION — 100% cash. Core principles proven over 44 trades: (1) Universal bearish MACD = no new positions, period. This has been validated repeatedly. (2) RE-ENTRY CRITERIA (strict): Wait for at least 3 stocks in a sector to show MACD bullish crossovers before entering. First crossover is a trap. (3) When re-entering, use concentrated entry on confirmed signals (research shows this outperforms DCA in trending markets), but start at 10% positions. (4) Profit-taking at +5-7% in MACD-bearish environments is non-negotiable — this rule generated 15 wins. (5) Cut relative weakness immediately — stocks underperforming SPY on any given day are sells. (6) WATCHLIST for first bullish crossovers: AMD, ORCL, MSFT, AVGO, AMZN — these showed recent relative strength. (7) 78.9% win rate means the system works. Don't deviate due to FOMO. Cash at ATH markets is a position.

V position is essentially flat (+0.12%) after being held for a week — it hasn't triggered the $309 stop loss but isn't confirming either. The DCA research suggests that concentrated re-entry on confirmed signals slightly outperforms DCA in strong trend environments, but DCA is safer in choppy markets like now.
